patterns.note: Content is presented within a fixed-width, centered container, maintaining generous horizontal padding and ample vertical spacing between distinct content blocks.
A clear typographic hierarchy is established using a single sans-serif font, featuring very large, bold headings for primary titles and highly readable, standard-sized body text.
The design primarily uses a stark white background with dark grey/black text, accented by soft, pastel-like gradient backgrounds for related content cards to provide subtle visual distinction.
The main navigation bar at the top of the page remains persistently sticky, maintaining its position and full size as the user scrolls down, without any visual transformations.
A 'Keep reading' section features a horizontal grid of three equally sized cards, each with a unique, soft gradient background and a clear text overlay.

technique_notes: The page employs a maximum-width content wrapper that centers all primary content, ensuring consistent readability and visual balance across different screen sizes.
The top navigation bar is implemented as a sticky element that maintains its fixed position at the top of the viewport during scroll, without any shrinking or background changes.
Content sections are visually separated by significant vertical whitespace, creating an airy and uncluttered reading experience that emphasizes content focus.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold display headings (~3-4x body) with clear, readable body text and smaller, subtle metadata for context.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners, consistently applied to interactive elements like buttons and content cards.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous vertical spacing between content blocks and sections, creating a sense of calm and focus.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its extreme clarity and content-first approach, achieved through a minimalist aesthetic and abundant whitespace. The subtle, pastel gradient backgrounds on the 'Keep reading' cards add a unique touch of visual interest without compromising the overall clean and authoritative feel.
